structured_output.summary: The change implements Iterator.prototype[Symbol.dispose] as the spec describes. It sets obj to this, calls ops::get_method(obj, "return") with the ? propagated, calls ops::call(ret, obj, []) with ? only when the result is not undefined, and returns undefined. No special-casing, no swallowed errors, no made-up values. The test262 gate reports 4 new passes and 0 regressions. The only nits are a leftover `let _ = (args, new_target);` that silences unused-variable warnings, and removal of the spec comment about the "name" property, which is not a step. Neither changes behaviour. I could not inspect ops::get_method or agent.names.r#return, but the build passes, so they exist with compatible signatures.
